<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0409-53-53" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">tho</rs> na re
            khyab ces pa yong ba dang ma khyab pa yong ba ma yin te gang rung sres kyang ma khyab pa
            dang khyab ches pa spangs paso || des na dmig nyid <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="39b6"/> kyi yul gzugs yin zhes
            pas ni yul can du nges par bstan la gzugs nyid mig yul yin pas ni yul du nges par bstan
            pas yul dang yul can du nges gi mi 'khrul bar bstan par bya ba'i phyis nges gsung sbyar
            ba yin zhes ro || 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">skyabs</rs> na re log yul gyi gzugs kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> mig dam po'i spyod yul gyi
            don zhes pa yin na | slu baswa laso pa'i cig spyod yul gyi don yin pas gzugs su 'byung
            zhing | 'dod pa yin te <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="39b7"/> saM gyi phyi rol gyi don khas blangs kyi lugs kyis
            den gzugs su mi 'dod paso ||
         des na bla ma 2 laso pa gsugs ma yin pa deg gcod par byed
            pa la 'byung mchen po na dag rgyu byas pa zhes pa <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> du smos dgos so zhes gsung |</seg></TEI>
